dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: Grief will not simply disappear. We can only let it slowly fade.

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: I once thought the world unjust for this reason, but will any amount of that change the past?

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: The more I can commit to the Iridescence Tour, the fewer opportunities there will be for sorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: Perhaps Dvorak, bless his good heart, was just trying to help get me on my feet when he asked for my assistance with the festival!
